info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Banking It Management System Deployment By System Deployment Id-v5-spec
info.description: This API allows users to retrieve details of a specific banking IT management system deployment using its unique system deployment ID. The primary resource managed here is the system deployment, which contains critical information on various IT deployments within the banking sector. Typical consumers of this API include IT administrators and developers involved in monitoring and managing system deployments. Use cases may involve verifying deployment statuses, troubleshooting issues, or auditing deployment histories.

get.summary: Retrieve system deployment details by ID
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed information about a specific system deployment using its unique identifier (RES-100045). It returns comprehensive data related to the deployment, including its current status, configuration, and associated resources.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the parameters and details required to execute the GET operation for the system deployment resource identified by RES-100045. The content is structured in JSON format and must conform to the specified schema.

200.description: The request was successful, and the response contains the requested data.

GetBankingItManagementSystemDeploymentBy.description: This schema represents the request body for the IT Management System Deployment operations, specifically for GET requests. The body is expected to be a JSON string.
